elections.words: Result to pay: how it is paid
Result to pay: at once or in two instalments
elections.help: Paying in two instalments adds no interest or surcharge. The return must be filed within its filing period, and a corrective return cannot be paid this way. The 60% is paid when you file; if it is not paid on time, the whole amount falls due. When the first instalment is direct-debited too, the second is charged to the same account.

choices.words: Two instalments: 60% when you file, the other 40% by direct debit
Two instalments: 60% when you file, the other 40% paid by you with Modelo 102

figures.advisory_words: Advisory: Cadrumo rounds the first instalment to the cent and leaves the rest to the second. No official rule says which instalment a cent goes to, so check both amounts in Renta WEB before you pay.
